title: Recorder: who is this for?
change: One field above the preview asks who the video is for. The answer names the video, the page and the link. Camera and microphone become one devices control, with the level meter inside it.
evidence: Nothing on the core path asks who the video is for: three takes and their pages were all Untitled Video. The ready screen had 16 controls.
notes: Device names are plausible Mac names instead of Chromium's fake devices, and the preview is a neutral poster instead of the green test pattern. The account footer shows the mock rep instead of the e2e account.
